subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘TEAM’ is coded as ‘41’, and ‘FEAD’ is coded as ‘18’. How will ‘GROW’ be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

**Logic : (2 + Sum of the position values according to English alphabetic series)**

So,

 
• ‘TEAM’ is coded as ‘41’

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2f33607169d5e077df6f9f4c6c212033801f43ba2db826fee1e5addf2823f2d.png] 

​And,

 
• ‘FEAD’ is coded as ‘18’

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/951f4c327285e4dc57d02a27b1e13d6d0be80e1a52ba5507a18cfcfc67672be9.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• ‘GROW’ ​is coded as ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65c7f5841f4373eda1b8d36dfc8203695164bf71e3145b6b6b70b83db1ceac27.png] 

Hence, **"65"** is the correct answer.
